Subscription cap groups are (account_id, subscription_id), not subscription_id alone. Compute each uncapped line credit as floor(charge_cents * 10 / 100), then allocate a shared 2400-cent group cap by earliest service_on then increasing Unicode-code-point line_id; assigned line credit is min(uncapped credit, remaining cap).
